Samir's availability (from TalentOps):
- Thu 25 Jun — 10:00–14:00 PDT
- Mon 29 Jun — 09:00–12:00 PDT

Proposed slots (all durations include 10m buffer between panels):
A) 10:00–10:40 — System design (30m + 10m buffer) — Laura + Markus as interviewer
B) 10:50–11:50 — Live coding (50m) — Marissa + Logan pair
C) 12:00–12:30 — Culture / leadership (25m) — Irene + hiring manager closeout

If Thu 25 looks good, we can lock it. Otherwise we can flip to Mon 29 morning. Attaching Samir's resume and a draft .ics we can send once we confirm.

Notes/caveats:
- Prefer coding block to be contiguous (no split).
- Requesting a short 10m async debrief window immediately after the loop for interviewer quick notes (we'll use Greenhouse rubric link below).

Attachments: Samir_Kapoor_Resume.pdf, full_loop_schedule.ics

Thanks,
Karthik

- Swap the sequence so design is first, coding second, culture last (I want Samir fresh for the architecture discussion).
- Can we shorten the culture block to 20m? We'll need to keep the total under 2 hours due to candidate constraints.
- Please assign a stronger domain interviewer on design — if Markus is busy, consider Marcus Lin (if available).

A quick ask on debriefs: let's add a 10-minute synchronous debrief slot at 12:35 (immediately after culture) for quick red/green. If any blockers, we can fall back to async notes in Greenhouse but prefer a 10-minute call if schedules permit.

Irene — can you lead the culture conversation if you have the bandwidth? Otherwise I can cover and close.
